origin: cwe/434/java Key Principles: MultipartFile.getContentType() and getOriginalFilename() are client-supplied metadata

finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: The Spring upload handler trusts the client-supplied multipart Content-Type header and later stores the upload under the client-supplied original filename.

trap: Adding an extension check, using Files.probeContentType() on the stored name, or generating a random name while preserving the client-chosen extension. The fix must inspect the file bytes, allowlist the real type, derive storage extension from that type, and update the returned/retrieval name.
must_preserve: Valid PNG and JPEG avatars still upload and return the stored filename, unsupported content fails before storage, and callers can retrieve the avatar by the server-generated name returned from store().
